options.name: Illustrated Journal
options.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a realistic, production-quality illustrated personal WEBSITE homepage for toli.me. Output one standalone website design, 1440 px wide by 1920 px high, a natural desktop full-page scroll screenshot. No browser chrome, device frame, presentation background or annotations. Current date October 3, 2026; do not show invented dates, numerical claims, achievements or bounty amounts.

This is the redesign from an illustrated map to a NORMAL website. Strong readable hierarchy, clear standard section navigation, ordinary scrolling, real titles, direct links. Keep character illustrations but eliminate maps, kingdoms, roads, capital cities, zoom/pan controls, floating islands, game UI, and mandatory exploration. Do not put the whole page inside a floating card. Use grouping, alignment, spacing and fine rules before card borders; no nested cards. No generic SaaS sales pitch, statistics, newsletter, login or invented features. Two fonts maximum, all body copy readable around 18px at this width.

References in order:
1 Existing Toli Land screen: ONLY warm ivory paper, dark forest ink, friendly watercolor character style; do NOT preserve map layout, navigation or old content.
2 Fresh PUBLIC Drawn homepage: preserve recognizable Toli*Drawn branding and use its actual visible illustrated comic-panel imagery as the basis of Drawn's preview. Its public comic covers depict humorous human scenes. Use a crisp visible comic excerpt/page as the featured artwork, not a generic pencil icon. The new site is toli.me, NOT a clone of Drawn's homepage.
3 Actual Neurodivergent Guide to the Workplace screenshot: use the support-network group illustration as reference for guide artwork. A book-character rendition with small paper arms and feet is a NEW proposed cover treatment; do not borrow the excluded Frontend Infra Book cover. Render heading on new site as "Neurodiverse Guide" and small descriptor "To the workplace".
4 Easter Creatures character illustration: retain these distinctive colorful creatures in the Creative area if shown.

CONTENT / HARD CONSTRAINTS:
Brand: "toli.me".
Plain navigation: "Publications", "Creative", "Writing", "Travels", "Work ↗". Work links externally to tolicodes.com.
Hero copy: "Hi, I'm Toli." with "Stories, strange little creations, and things I've learned along the way." Keep introduction modest and personal.
The THREE most prominent FEATURED destinations must be exactly:
"Drawn" — "Life, in comic form." — "Read the comics ↗".
"Neurodiverse Guide" — "Making work work for different minds." — "Read the guide ↗".
"Dating Bounty" — "A very personal side project." — "Take a look ↗".
Dating Bounty REPLACES Principles in the main featured area. Give it equal clarity and a large memorable illustration: a blush pink letter/envelope with a red heart seal, paper hands and little feet holding a tiny friendly matchmaking note. This is a proposed mascot, not verified existing project branding. NO money amount, dollar sign, active-status badge, invented eligibility or current offer.
Principles belongs ONLY in the lower Publications area, clearly secondary to the featured trio.

Remaining site content may continue below the fold; avoid cramming every retained destination into this frame. In visible secondary areas use ONLY retained content:
Publications: Neurodiverse Guide, Principles.
Creative: Drawn, Easter Creatures, Las Chicas, Spa Date, Obscure Parody Videos.
Writing retains these six titles: "Getting Back to Love"; "Energy Cords and Foreign Energy in your Aura"; "Why We Focus on the Negative and How Can We Change It"; "Rejection, Breakups, Vulnerability, and BDSM"; "The Problem with Boredom and Bipolar"; "DOTA and Consciousness". You may show three readable sample rows and a "All writing →" link as the rest continues below. No false publishing dates or reading-time claims.
Travels: one understated "Travels ↗" entry with an illustrated stack of postcards; do not invent locations, trip records or photos presented as real.
End with a small "Say hello ↗" when space permits.
No engineering portfolio projects, LeetCode, PickleJS, FE Infra Book, FB Ads Book, Speaking or Hobbies. Maintain natural text placement and impeccable spelling. One coherent designed page, not a collage of alternative pages.
DIRECTION NAME: Illustrated Journal. Quiet warm cream paper with deep forest-green ink and restrained terracotta/blush accents. A refined editorial serif for large headings paired with a crisp humanist sans-serif for navigation/body. Header within generous 80px margins; hero text immediately below, no enormous blank spacer. Three equal-width FEATURED columns in one row with generous freestanding artwork above their labels, not heavy boxed cards. Left a tactile comic page; center a charming warm blue/lilac guide book-character with the support-group illustration on its cover; right a lively blush letter-character for Dating Bounty. These form the main visual rhythm. Below, an elegant two-column Writing section with three real essay titles and one-line modest topic previews; on the other side a small Creative selection with Easter Creatures and two text links. Lower down a simple Publications row that clearly includes Principles, plus Travels and remaining Creative links. Calm, spacious, grown-up, playful in the artwork. Every visible title and link feels easy to click. Absolutely no map, roads or category mascots as navigation.
